content.text:
**Finding: deviation (ASSIGN, high severity) — § 15 Assignment or Transfer (p0080).**

- The document contains one assignment provision and no change-of-control language at all, so the walk-away risk of a Vendor CoC termination/re-pricing right is absent.
- But § 15 requires prior written approval for any assignment with **no reasonableness standard** and **no successor/M&A carve-out** — only a "financially responsible affiliate" exception. TrueLink could therefore block our merger, reorganisation or asset sale, which fails even the fallback (successor assignment on notice + consent not unreasonably withheld).
- Redline (validated ok:true) keeps the mutual structure but adds: (a) consent "not unreasonably withheld or delayed"; (b) Client assignment on notice to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all assets/equity; (c) bar on TrueLink assigning to a competitor of Client; (d) confirmation that a Client change of control is not a deemed assignment and gives TrueLink no termination, suspension or re-pricing right.
- Fallback offered in the comment: a fully mutual successor-assignment-on-notice formulation if TrueLink resists the asymmetry.
